articles.title: 'Howard Tucker, the world's oldest doctor, left us the three keys to longevity: "You must have a purpose"'
articles.standfirst: The American neurologist died in December 2025
articles.summary: The American neurologist died in December 2025
articles.body:
Howard Tucker held the Guinness record for the world's oldest practicing physician. The American neurologist died in December 2025 at the age of 103 , but he left us with the great biological and emotional secret to a long life. " Retirement is the enemy of longevity . You must have a purpose in life , get up in the morning, and know who you are," the physician said in an interview with Today.

Having a clear goal in your day-to-day life means, according to the doctor, that you stay connected and prevents your mind from retiring . In addition to this general reflection, in an essay written for CNBC shortly before his death and published with his family's permission, Howard Tucker shared the three keys that, according to him, are essential to having a long and fulfilling life. His three pieces of advice go beyond diet or exercise and are lessons on how to face our existence.

The three keys to Howard Tucker's longevity

The first key to maintaining longevity, according to the essay by neurologist Howard Tucker , is to keep the mind occupied. In short, to avoid mental retirement. "The mind is like any other muscle in the body. If it is not used, it weakens," he explained. The doctor argued that keeping the brain active does not necessarily have to involve a job. "It can mean volunteering, reading, learning a skill, playing music, joining a club...", he wrote for CNBC.

The second great lesson the American physician left us is to avoid hatred. "Your attitude toward life matters (...). I've been here a long time. Like everyone else, I experience disappointment, loss, and injustice. But I never think it makes sense to carry hatred," Howard Tucker confessed. The neurologist argued that harboring negative feelings consumes energy and affects us emotionally and physically. "The important thing is not to let resentment dominate your life" , the specialist concluded.

The third and final piece of advice is to make the most of life. Enjoy it. Although in moderation: " For me, moderation is what allows you to enjoy things in the long term . Have a sensible attitude toward what you eat. The same applies in many aspects of life. Too much of anything can wear you out, just like too little." Howard Tucker urged his readers to enjoy life to the fullest, with common sense, control, and purpose. That is how he reached 103 years of age and became a medical reference in the field of longevity.

articles.title: Jackson Johnson, personal trainer: "You’re not going to get defined abs just by doing a good core routine..."
articles.standfirst: Many people make the mistake of believing that if they do a good ab routine, they will define it
articles.summary: Many people make the mistake of believing that if they do a good ab routine, they will define it
articles.body:
One of the crucial parts of a physical transformation and in almost any training is the core area. This area is fundamental because it supports the rest of the body and provides guidance to the other areas. Having a strong core is an extremely important matter, and we must focus on it. However, many people also want to have defined abs and do exercises thinking they will achieve this through their core routine. But, for personal trainer Jackson Johnson, this would not be so simple, and other types of training would be needed to reduce abdominal fat and have a flat and strong stomach.

The ab routine, yes, but not only that

The cited trainer mentions that abdominal routines are necessary and, at times, we must incorporate those that work the core deeply. However, he mentions that doing only that (unless you have heart problems) is useless.

Many people believe that because they do a daily ab routine they will achieve defined abs; however, this is a very widespread lie. The first thing that must be done is to reduce abdominal fat, usually by losing weight in a healthy way and as long as it is necessary in your case.

However, it is also important that we consider that the abdomen is not like other muscles , such as the biceps, for example, which are trained in the gym with weights and grow. The abdomen is not like that, since they are beneath the abdominal fat and come to light when this weight is lost . Therefore, we must be aware that they are a visual separation and that their transformation is going to be slow and defined.

Having very defined abs, is it just training?

Many women want a defined abdomen and look for it in the gym; however, the trainer mentions that it can be achieved (or not) for two different reasons. One, and perhaps the main one, is genetics ; if you are not predisposed to having it defined, it will be very complex for you to ever have it, although it can always improve.

The second and fundamental issue for having defined abs is that you are in a calorie deficit , which means that you need to eat fewer calories than your body uses and burns on a day-to-day basis for a long time. For that reason, it is important not to obsess over having hyper-defined abs; rather, we should take care of ourselves, keep our core strong, and reduce abdominal fat more for health than for aesthetics.
